acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Dan Taberski takes us into the world of the TV shows Cops and Live PD. And talks to people about what it’s like to be caught by the police and caught on camera at the same time. Dan is the host of the podcast “ Running from COPS,” from Pineapple Street Media and Topic Studios.
acts.title: Anything You Say Can And Will Be Used...on Television

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: One of our producers Bim Adewunmi explains her obsession with a certain baby on television.
acts.title: Born to Play the Part

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Producer Lina Misitzis revisits a moment in a TV special that’s stuck with her for over twenty years.
acts.title: Lina with an N
